purpose: Teach: 逐次/紀元前/派兵/軽蔑/露呈/否決/法務大臣/会計検査院

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、年表を逐次確認する手法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered chronological verification methods in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Gentle confirmation phrased as a question. Teacher leaning in slightly, genuinely curious about the student's work. Steady pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、紀元前文明の謎を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the mysteries of pre-civilization societies.
lines.style: Straightforward, honest answer. Slight lift at the beginning, showing willingness to share. Calm confidence underneath. No performance, just clear engagement with the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代国家の派兵史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined the deployment history of modern nation-states in another paper?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Each phrase deliberate, as if considering the significance of the work. Warm but measured. Inviting the student to confirm while showing genuine interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、社会の中の軽蔑構造を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I explored how hierarchies of contempt function within societies.
lines.style: Steady, serious tone. Speaking carefully about a sensitive topic. No hesitation — this is important work. Direct eye contact level in the voice, mature but still young.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織問題が露呈した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: In your next paper, you tackled a case where organizational problems became exposed?
lines.style: Slightly more energized. Teacher recognizing the ambition of the work. Forward lean in the voice. Nodding approval built into the rhythm. Still professional but genuinely impressed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、議会で否決された法案を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I analyzed a bill that was rejected in the Diet.
lines.style: Confident delivery. The word 'Diet' lands with appropriate weight — specific, formal. Clear and direct. Young voice but speaking with the clarity of someone who has done the research thoroughly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 法務大臣の権限を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the final paper — the Minister of Justice's authority and jurisdiction?
lines.style: Reflective pull back. Teacher summarizing, checking the arc of the conversation. Slower pace. Warm recognition of the scope and complexity. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、会計検査院の役割を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my focus was on the role and oversight function of the Board of Audit.
lines.style: Measured conclusion. Calm, assured tone. Slight softening at the end — finishing the thought without over-explanation. Student showing maturity and clarity. Natural close to the exchange.
